card.name: Setting up a claim as mistaken
card.fires_on: Words in opinion or argument text where a common belief has just been raised and the writer is about to call it wrong, such as 'anyone who thinks', 'to think so is', or 'you'd be wrong'.

modes.label: Belief verbs
modes.description: Verbs like thinks or thought that introduce a belief the writer will dispute.
modes.example: But anyone who<< thinks>> we’re getting something great for our dollars

modes.description: Words such as mistake or misunderstanding that label a view as wrong.

modes.label: Rebuttal framing
modes.description: Small words in a sentence that restates or rejects a claim, such as is, be, the or what.
modes.example: To think so<< is>> a basic misunderstanding of the place of art
